Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥349,876 million, the largest of the reportable segments (previous year: ¥403,479 million). The company explains that, due to an incident at its subsidiary Fuji Television Network, Inc., terrestrial TV advertising revenue fell sharply, mainly in the first half. entries.2e05878cf5b1c51e: In May 2026, the company published 'Group Vision 2026-2030 Ver.1.0.' The company says it will shift from the conventional structure, in which terrestrial TV advertising revenue is the main source of income, to a system that consistently covers everything from creating and nurturing IP to diversified expansion, starting from IP and content. Terrestrial broadcasting will be repositioned as the core for developing IP.
